The transformation kernel is complete source support, a total held map, exact predecessor fibres, exhaustive retained/closed source distinctions, singleton-fibre reversibility, held reverse records, compositional retention monotonicity and no unrecorded information source.

registration.statement: An information transformation is a total single-valued map over complete source support. Every source distinction is conserved as an image distinction or closed inside an exact predecessor fibre; these two ledgers are disjoint and exhaustive. Reversibility is forced exactly by singleton fibres. An irreversible transformation can be reversed only when a retained predecessor label resolves each non-singleton fibre. Under composition, downstream retained distinctions are a subset of those retained upstream, so a map creates no unrecorded source distinction.
registration.title: Exact information conservation, loss and transformation
